description: Extends F1a with speed-dependent mechanical losses (friction, drivetrain) and partial-load motor/generator efficiency curves
source: Botha & Kamper (2019), J. Energy Storage, 23, 159-174; Berrada et al. (2017), Energy Conversion and Management, 137, 191-200; Pyrhonen et al. (2013), Design of Rotating Electrical Machines

unit.name: Generic Solid-Mass Gravity Storage (e.g., Energy Vault / mineshaft)

motor_gen_plf_exp.note: Part-load exponent n: eta_mg(PLF) = 1 - (1-eta_rated)*(1 + (PLF-1)^n); n=2 typical induction motor

friction_coeff.note: Coulomb friction coefficient at guide surfaces

cable_drag_k.note: Aerodynamic drag coefficient of cable/mass: P_drag = k * v^2

bearing_loss_frac.note: Bearing/seal loss as fraction of instantaneous mechanical power
